urgentSigns.heading: Urgent signs, even in comfort care
urgentSigns.lead: Call the vet, an emergency vet, or the hospice vet for any of these:

items.title: Bloat (GDV, gastric dilatation-volvulus)
items.note: Weimaraners are a high-risk breed. Bloat usually needs surgery, so decide the plan in advance with the vet (VQ-9).

items.title: Breathing
signs: labored breathing, or a resting rate staying above the normal range

items.title: Pain
signs: pain that medications no longer control

items.title: Urine
signs: no urine for many hours while on a diuretic

items.title: Vomiting or stool
signs: repeated vomiting, or black, tarry stool

breathing: A rate consistently above the normal range: call the vet soon.
Labored breathing, a blue or gray tongue, or collapse: urgent.
